metadata.title: Hs / CNQ-Tiling: Deterministic Scaling to High Dimensions - Claude Context Package
metadata.author: Peter Higgins (human authorship for claims); AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001
metadata.purpose: Continuity context for Claude. Captures today's thread (a Grok conversation Peter forwarded that climbed from the geology-wehner repo update through CNQ-tiling transition maps into a tower of differential geometry, then asked the practical question: native D=8/D=16 quaternion engines, or D=4 tiling + mapping, to reach D~100,000?). This package preserves the thread AND adds the honest claim-tiering and the division-algebra/Clifford correction that the source thread did not make.
metadata.relationship_to_grok_json: This supersedes the uploaded HS_CNQ_Tiling_HighD_Deterministic_Summary.json (Grok-authored). That file is useful but lists Chern-Simons forms, Berry-phase monopoles, and instanton numbers as 'tools preserved' / 'already realized', which is not accurate: by Grok's own admission none of it is computed, implemented, or shown to apply. Here those items are demoted to Tier 3 (speculative, unearned).

core_value_being_protected.statement: Hs must remain purely deterministic. Same input, same output, always, with a hash chain from raw vector to result (HUF-STD-002). This is the moat versus the mainstream high-D toolkit (PCA/UMAP, probabilistic embeddings, sampling), which discards information and is not reproducible bit-for-bit.
core_value_being_protected.implication: Any high-D scaling strategy that introduces statistics or lossy reduction is disqualified, regardless of convenience.

the_question_posed: Plans exist to build D=8 then D=16 quaternion 'twin/quad' engines. Does a D=16 engine buy anything if a D=4 engine plus a mapping method already exists, or is mapping D=16 segments more efficient for higher dimensions? Stated goal: reach D~100,000 for microbiome research (hot at CoDaWork 2026, and in medical research and oceanography). Peter's own note: this is possible for CNT, but not for CNQ due to massive combinatorial factors.

verdict.headline: Do not build native D=8 or D=16 quaternion engines. The exactness that makes CNQ valuable is a property of D=4 specifically. Carry it to higher D by tiling D=4 charts with explicit deterministic transition maps. If a truly native high-D exact rotor is ever wanted, the correct vehicle is a Clifford-algebra rotor (Spin(n)), not a 'bigger quaternion'.
verdict.why_D4_is_special: A 4-part composition has 3 ILR coordinates = dim of the imaginary part of the quaternions H; unit quaternions form S^3 = SU(2), double-covering SO(3). So a compositional move IS a rotation, composing moves IS quaternion multiplication, path reversal IS conjugation. Exactness and atan2-stable numerics follow.
verdict.division_algebra_argument: Hurwitz: normed division algebras over R exist only in dimensions 1 (R), 2 (C), 4 (H), 8 (O). Only R, C, H are associative, which is what lets unit elements form a group that composes rotations. D=4 (H) is the LARGEST case where compositional moves become a clean rotation group. Cayley-Dickson 'twin' = octonions (D=8): keeps division but LOSES associativity, so unit elements are not a group and sandwich conjugation no longer composes as multiplication - the transition-map/holonomy/SLERP machinery has no group to live in. Cayley-Dickson 'quad' = sedenions (D=16): LOSES the division property itself (has zero divisors, nonzero x nonzero = 0), so exact invertible navigation breaks at the algebra level. 'Native D=16 quaternion' is therefore a category error.
verdict.clifford_alternative: Clifford (geometric) algebras are associative in EVERY dimension; their even-subalgebra unit elements form Spin(n), a Lie group double-covering SO(n), acting by exact sandwich rotations on any number of axes. Quaternions are the n=3 case (H = Cl+(3) = Spin(3)). This is the rigorous meaning of 'go native to higher D'. Cost: a from-scratch rotor engine and loss of the tidy per-axis 3D helmsman picture. Keep on record as the principled native option; do not build now.

A_D4_tiling_plus_mapping.description: Cover the high-D simplex with overlapping exact 4-part charts; glue with explicit ILR->quaternion transition maps. Reuses the existing engine; keeps 3-DOF-per-chart interpretability (helmsman, bearing) that field scientists read.
A_D4_tiling_plus_mapping.status_for_microbiome: Pragmatic winner: code reuse + interpretability + already partway built.

B_clifford_rotor_Spin_n.description: One native rotor in D-1 dimensions, associative and exact in all D. The cleaner generalization but a larger build with less intuitive output (rotors mix many planes; harder to read as a single helmsman).
B_clifford_rotor_Spin_n.status: Principled native option for a possible future single-engine hardware target. Record, do not build now.

two_exact_deterministic_paths.do_not_do: Octonion/sedenion 'twin/quad' engines. They sit in the one place that sacrifices the properties Hs sells (associativity at 8, division at 16).

tier_1_verified_computed: D=4 ILR->quaternion construction is exact; engine runs deterministically.

5-part transition map: shared Helmert contrasts z1,z2 are normalization-invariant; only z3 shifts, by -(sqrt(3)/2)*ln(x5/x4). RE-CHECKED NUMERICALLY 2026-06-10: max deviation 3.6e-15 over 100,000 random 5-part compositions.
CNT is deterministic and reduces each step in linear work.
tier_2_standard_math_soundly_applied: Hurwitz theorem + Cayley-Dickson loss of associativity (D=8) then division (D=16): textbook; 'don't build native twin/quad' is a direct consequence.
Clifford/Spin(n) rotors as the associative high-D generalization of quaternions: textbook geometric algebra.
SLERP as exact geodesic interpolation on S^3.
tier_3_unverified_not_yet_earned_DO_NOT_: That a full atlas of overlapping D=4 charts reconstructs an arbitrary high-D trajectory LOSSLESSLY AT SCALE - proven only on a small worked case; atlas-construction algorithm does not yet exist.
Phylogenetic/hierarchical atlas for D~100k microbiome - sound, natural, UNBUILT and UNBENCHMARKED.

The entire differential-geometry tower from the source thread: curvature 2-form, Ambrose-Singer holonomy, Chern-Weil classes, Chern-Simons 3-forms, Berry-phase monopoles, Yang-Mills instanton numbers applied to a 'CNQ principal bundle'. Real mathematics by ANALOGY. NONE computed, implemented, or shown to apply. The claimed isometry/connection structure is asserted, not established. Must NOT appear in any Matthew-facing, agency-facing, or repo headline material as a property the system HAS. To earn any of it: define the bundle and connection precisely; PROVE the lift of an ILR shift to quaternion multiplication is actually a group homomorphism (currently hand-waved); then compute one invariant on real data and check it.

todays_thread_outline.note: Peter forwarded a Grok conversation. Faithful topic-by-topic outline below; full verbatim text is in Peter's chat, not duplicated here.
sequence: Grok reviewed the live geology-wehner repo update (post-CoDaWork): mudstone chemostratigraphy, CNQ-tiling/faceted reconstruction, geosensing, flight-spec suite. Accurate, favorable summary.
Explained CNQ-tiling: overlapping exact D=4 charts as an atlas over the high-D compositional manifold.
Derived transition maps between overlapping charts (ILR coordinate change in a fixed Helmert basis). VERIFIED CORRECT here.
Explicit 5-part coefficients: z1,z2 invariant; z3 shift = -(sqrt(3)/2)*ln(x5/x4). VERIFIED.

Lifted the ILR shift to a quaternion transition (left/right multiplication by exp(0.5*Delta*u_hat)). NOTE: the claim that an ILR translation lifts to group multiplication is asserted, not proven - this is the seam where Tier-2 becomes Tier-3.
Built upward: 4x4 matrix forms, Lie-algebra generators G_R/G_L, sandwich-product transformation, helmsman-sign transformation rule.
Multi-part transitions, SLERP interpolation, multi-way SLERP algorithm, geodesic distance on S^3.

Then climbed into: curvature corrections (BCH), holonomy around triangular loops, second-order commutator formula, Ambrose-Singer theorem, Chern-Weil theory, Yang-Mills instanton number, Berry-phase monopoles, Chern-Simons forms.
Grok repeatedly admitted these are NOT computed on Frielingen-9 and 'not yet evaluated' / 'conceptually present' - i.e., self-flagged as unearned.
Provided Python sketches for Berry-phase detection and a Chern-Simons proxy integral (illustrative stubs, not validated).
FINAL practical question (the real point): native D=8/D=16 engines vs D=4 tiling+mapping, target D~100,000 microbiome; CNT can scale but CNQ faces combinatorial factors.

Grok's answer: don't build native higher-D quaternion engines; use D=4 tiling + phylogenetic atlas. CORRECT conclusion, but under-argued (missed the decisive division-algebra reason and the Clifford alternative) and over-claimed the geometry tower as 'realized'.

honest_broker_assessment.what_is_solid: The strategic decision is right and the transition-map foundation is verified. The determinism-as-moat framing is correct. CNT linear scaling is real.
honest_broker_assessment.what_was_over_claimed_in_source: The differential-geometry tower was presented as 'already conceptually realized in the repository'. It is not. It is analogy + conjecture with no computation and an unproven group-homomorphism lift at its base.
honest_broker_assessment.what_this_package_adds: (1) The decisive division-algebra argument (Hurwitz + Cayley-Dickson) for why native D=8/D=16 is wrong. (2) The Clifford/Spin(n) rotor as the actual 'native high-D' option. (3) Numerical re-verification of the 5-part transition map. (4) Strict claim-tiering that quarantines the unearned geometry.
honest_broker_assessment.guidance_for_future_sessions: Keep the geometry tower in a clearly-labelled research appendix. Do not let it into Matthew-facing, agency-facing, or repo-headline material. The next earned step, if pursued, is to define the CNQ bundle/connection precisely and prove the ILR-shift -> quaternion-multiplication lift is a homomorphism, then compute exactly ONE invariant on real data.

action_items: Use CNT as the deterministic linear-scaling workhorse across the full D~100k field (screening, navigation, regime/outlier detection).
Apply D=4 CNQ-tiling selectively on structurally coherent sub-manifolds where exact helmsman/bearing read-out adds value.

BUILD the atlas layer (the one genuinely new build): for microbiome, a taxonomic-tree covering into overlapping 4-clade charts; benchmark charts-count and reconstruction error vs D. This is the Tier-3 -> Tier-1 gate.
Record Clifford/Spin(n) as the principled native-rotor alternative for a possible future hardware target; do not build now.
Quarantine the differential-geometry tower as a research appendix until at least one invariant is defined and computed on real data; keep it out of claims.
Preserve strict determinism and hash-chainability at every layer - non-negotiable core value.
one_line_headline_safe_to_carry_anywhere: Hs scales to arbitrarily high dimension while staying purely deterministic, by tiling the one dimension (D=4) where compositional moves are exact rotations - not by inventing a bigger algebra.
